# Rows: the 182 of docs/phase4/AUDIT-h6-handown-go1.26.9.md section 4 at 47ebebf76c77885ecdbfa8f8cebe372ae7e3361f, in table order.
# Roots: the H5 re-run stage on i9; h4a converted at go1.24.13 and h5 at go1.26.9 from ONE binary (sha256
#   cea40a5d6f9c...), each seeded from the landing e0e95b3424 with its own pin. h5 is the root AFTER H5c -Apply.
# side_file: the file the pair compares, by the go124 audit's sides -- 'auto:<path>.cs.auto' for an .auto
#   differential, 'principal:<principal .cs>' for a *_impl.cs whose principal the audit names (the principal's
#   converted .cs at each release), '-' for a principal NOT named (derived per row by its lane) or a manual
#   upstream diff (no converter side). A principal the audit spells per-GOOS in brace form, e.g.
#   'runtime/{windows,linux,darwin}/trace.cs', is three files: its hash and written columns read
# sha256: of the root's bytes as they lie on disk, or 'absent'. written: 'run' when the file is newer than that
#   root's sentinel, 'seed' when it is not -- a seed file is either an identical re-emission (the converter skips
#   an identical write) or a stale seed copy, which mtime cannot separate.
